text: Sorry to ring so late, Im his nan and Ive been up with him for hours and Im shattered. Callum is 5, temp was 39.7 about 20 mins ago. He keeps putting his hands over his eyes and says the big light hurts, so Ive got just the hall light on. He's gone all floppy on me, like a rag doll, and when I call his name he doesnt really answer me the way he normaly would. I had to shake him a bit to get him to look at me, I think? Thing is he wont actualy settle to sleep either, just sort of lies there. No fits or shaking or jerking or anything like that, I've been watching him the whole time. Not sure if I'm overreacting but he's not himself at all
